response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.transref, t.ordertypedist, s.shortintrt, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = s.transref), transaction_averages AS (SELECT transref, ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio FROM matched GROUP BY transref, ordertypedist), mix_averages AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS mix_avg_short_interest FROM matched GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT ta.transref, ta.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, ta.avg_short_interest, ta.avg_option_volume_ratio, ta.avg_short_interest / NULLIF(ma.mix_avg_short_interest, 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM transaction_averages AS ta JOIN mix_averages AS ma ON ta.ordertypedist IS ma.ordertypedist ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
